1.

Applicant-Prashant Kumar Gautam has approached this Court by way of filing present bail
application seeking enlargement on bail in Case Crime No. 203 of 2019, under Sections 328, 498A,
304 Ipc and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station B.B. Nagar, District Bulandshahar.
2.  This application is pending for about two and half years.
Sri Omvir Singh Rajpoot and Sikandar Khan, learned counsel for applicant are not present.
On 15.02.2024 also counsel for applicant was not present.

Earlier also this application was adjourned on the request of counsel for applicant on 31.03.2022 and 26.04.2022.
3.

Sri Roshan Kumar Singh, learned AGA appearing for State, submits that applicant is husband of deceased, who died within two years of her marriage and according to post mortem report Prashant Kumar Gautam vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75013568/
1

sentences.text: immediate cause of death was not ascertained and Viscera was preserved.
As per Viscera report poisonous substance was found.

4. In aforesaid circumstances, considering that applicant is in jail for about four years and present status of trial is not on record, therefore, even in absence of counsel for applicant, in the interest of justice, this application is disposed of with observation that in case trial is not substantially proceeded within six months from today, application will have liberty to approach this Court or Trial Court concerned, as advised, afresh alongwith status of trial.
5.
A copy of this order be communicated to applicant through Jail Superintendent concerned.
